title: Questions 181-185 refer to the following schedule and e-mail.

To:Jonah Weiss <j.weiss@bellrosebooks.com>
From:Priscilla Adeoye <p.adeoye@bellrosebooks.com>
Date:October 3
Subject:Orientation

Dear Mr. Weiss,

I have been through the schedule you drafted for the incoming affiliates. On the whole it looks very good, but I have one suggestion about the tour in the morning.

Rather than a walk through the central library, I recommend that the affiliates be taken around the new automated sorting hall and the rare-book restoration room. Those areas will interest them far more than the library floor.

Could you also make sure that Ilaria Costa is introduced during the afternoon workshop? As regional stock manager she will be their main point of contact for monthly reorders, so it is important that they know who she is.

Thank you for all the work you have put into this.

Best regards,

Priscilla Adeoye
Director of Affiliate Relations
